attchmntText: Pokarna Limited has informed the Exchange about Newspaper Publication of the  Extracts of Standalone & Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results  of the Company for the Quarter and the half year ended September 30, 2026, published today i.e. Wednesday, November 04, 2026 in Business Standard (English Newspaper) and Nava Telangana (Telugu Newspaper).

Pokarna Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the approved Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) along with Limited Review Report of the Company for the second quarter and the half year ended on September 30, 2026 & Code of practices and procedures for fair Disclosure of UPSI.
